content.comment_body: Hi, I’m experiencing issues with my INSYS GSM device communicating with my [product_name]. I’ve tried several methods to troubleshoot. When I trigger an alarm input directly to the INSYS GSM, it responds. However, when running the program with [product_name], the INSYS device does not reply and there’s no RX/TX activity. Sending a 'STATUS?' SMS causes brief flashes on the RX/TX LED and the status LED blinks three times, but I don’t receive any response. The history log shows 'GSM ERROR'. My [product_name] has part number [article_no] and my PC cable has part number [article_no]. Please review the attached INSYS configuration settings.
Thread closed because this question is already posted in another thread about INSYS GSM communicating with [product_name]. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: A user reports connectivity problems between INSYS GSM and [product_name], noting successful manual responses but failures when integrated with [product_name]. LEDs indicate attempted communication, and an error appears in logs. The user has checked hardware and settings, suggesting possible compatibility or setup issues between the two devices.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects reliable communication between INSYS GSM and [product_name] to allow remote status feedback and alarm management, functioning as configured.
